source_snapshot.procedure: Two conflicting DRAM/MCA BIOS profiles precede one CE at fixed address0x1000 with no slot selector.
source_snapshot.criteria: Tool PASS plus OS report within undefined timeout.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; generic memory logs cannot prove slot coverage.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires address-to-slot map, profile semantics and per-slot evidence.

old_problem: A single unmapped low address could not cover Memory slot1~N, and contradictory DRAM and MCA counter profiles had no defined relationship or separate evidence.
disposition_reason: The CE purpose and per-slot acceptance are clear. To avoid silently dropping either source profile, the review treats DRAM1.1 and MCA1.2 as independent profile checkpoints unless a signed project specification proves one inapplicable; they are never applied cumulatively by assumption. ED-03 permits platform-decoded reserved pages and topology as runtime inputs, while ED-16 gates every one-shot injection.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row 42, AI fields, historical record 2445 and next pending row 43.
Preserved every populated slot and both listed BIOS profiles as separate coverage identities.
Rejected 0x1000 until an address decoder proves a backed owned page and exact slot/UMC/rank.
Required Linux MCA/APEI/rasdaemon or Windows WHEA plus BMC slot attribution and memory health.
No BIOS/HDT, page allocation or injection action occurred.

test_case.test_name: AMD DRAM correctable ECC per slot and profile
test_case.purpose: For every required populated DIMM slot, demonstrate an attributable correctable ECC event under each independently approved DRAM1.1 and MCA1.2 profile without memory-service degradation.
required_package: Safe pinned/backed non-reserved page per slot/profile
AMD tool/spec hash/license and address/mask/mcapolling/errortype0 contract
Defined DRAM1.1 and MCA1.2 independent profile settings and applicability
Per-slot OS/BMC oracle, timeout, abort and full restoration
test_case.test_command: Build a signed slot-to-page map. For one profile and one slot only, apply that profile's captured settings, validate the page is owned/pinned and decodes to the target, then have the FAE inject one CE. Correlate tool, OS and management slot evidence with memory health, restore the profile and page, and separately authorize the next profile/slot.
test_case.expected_result: Every in-scope slot under each applicable profile records the intended CE at the decoded location within timeout; memory service stays healthy, no UCE/reset/persistent poison occurs and all BIOS/HDT/page state is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete slot/profile matrix, address proof, tool PASS plus attributable CE and healthy memory. Fixed 0x1000, generic ECC text, cumulative profile guessing, wrong slot or severity escalation fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated ECC SUT, backup and OOB console.
Never inject an unowned, unpinned, firmware/MMIO/reserved or unverified page.
One slot/profile checkpoint at a time; abort on wrong slot, UCE, storm, reset or health decline.
No automatic retry; disable injection and release test pages during restoration.
expected_evidence: DIMM topology and per-slot decoded page map
Package provenance and full per-checkpoint command transcript
Attributed MCA/APEI/rasdaemon or WHEA plus BMC/UEFI slot record
Memory integrity, cleanup, restoration and verdict
test_case.recovery: On misattribution or escalation, stop the matrix, preserve address/tool/event evidence, use approved OOB memory recovery, disable injection, release/clean the test page and restore that profile before any new approval.

source_conflict.reason: The two source profiles become independent checkpoints and every slot receives a decoded safe page instead of the universal 0x1000 value.

blocked.reason: Method, oracle and recovery are complete; physical topology/pages and signed package remain execution prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Slot/address map, profile applicability, AMD CE contract, timeouts and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED AS PARAMETERIZED PER-SLOT CE MATRIX; NOT EXECUTED
pending.owner: AMD memory-RAS owner and qualified FAE execute; engineer owns verdict.
pending.unlock_condition: Bind each profile/slot to a safe decoded page and signed one-shot recipe.

project_authority: Platform address decoding and the approved AMD RAS specification define target identity and profile semantics.
